notes: N-317: hostile UTXO scripts. matches = matchesArtifact(artifacts[artifact], script): 'match' (true), 'no_match' (false), or 'malformed' (the tier's typed malformed-script error; any other exception, panic or timeout is a failure). wallet = whether TokenWallet.getUtxos keeps a UTXO with this script (null: not part of the wallet replay). script = prefix + repeat*count + suffix. The whole replay must finish within a CPU-time budget. Replayed by all 7 SDKs.

cases.name: stateful-genuine
cases.why: honest deployment (RunarContract.getLockingScript, supply=0x2211; state as the SDK serialises it): ctor arg 021122, code-part length 16

cases.name: stateful-odd-length-code-part
cases.why: odd number of hex chars, no state section

cases.name: stateful-odd-length-state
cases.why: genuine code part, odd-length state section

cases.name: stateful-non-hex-at-slot
cases.why: non-hex byte where the ctor push opcode is read

cases.name: stateful-partial-hex-at-slot
cases.why: '0g' at the slot: TS parseInt read it as OP_0 (prefix parse) and the rest matched; Java threw NumberFormatException, not the typed error

cases.name: stateful-non-hex-in-state
cases.why: genuine code part, non-hex state section

cases.name: stateful-non-ascii
cases.why: a non-ASCII char replaces one hex digit of the ctor push, straddling a byte window (Rust: slicing off a char boundary panics)

cases.name: stateful-truncated-pushdata1
cases.why: OP_PUSHDATA1 with no length byte

cases.name: stateful-truncated-pushdata1-payload
cases.why: OP_PUSHDATA1 declares 5 bytes, 2 remain

cases.name: stateful-truncated-pushdata2
cases.why: OP_PUSHDATA2 declares 1 byte, none remain

cases.name: stateful-truncated-pushdata4
cases.why: OP_PUSHDATA4 declares 1 byte, none remain

cases.name: stateful-pushdata4-high-bit-length
cases.why: OP_PUSHDATA4 length 0x80000000: signed 32-bit length arithmetic goes negative (TS: findLastOpReturn never terminates)

cases.name: stateful-pushdata4-ffffffff-length
cases.why: OP_PUSHDATA4 length 0xffffffff (Java: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException escaped getUtxos)

cases.name: stateful-push-runs-past-end
cases.why: ctor push declares 5 bytes but the script ends after 3

cases.name: stateful-push-swallows-next-segment
cases.why: ctor push consumes the bytes the template expects after the slot

cases.name: stateful-empty
cases.why: empty script (getUtxos includes empty-script UTXOs by design, so not in the wallet replay)

cases.name: stateful-shorter-than-template
cases.why: ends before the first slot

cases.name: stateful-ends-at-slot
cases.why: ends exactly where the ctor push opcode must be read

cases.name: stateful-wrong-code-part-length
cases.why: code-part length field is one more than the code part

cases.name: stateful-large-genuine
cases.why: 1 MiB ctor arg (OP_PUSHDATA4), honest code-part length

cases.name: stateful-large-high-bit-pushdata4
cases.why: ~1 MiB of OP_PUSHDATA4 0x80000000 headers

cases.name: stateful-large-zeros
cases.why: 1 MiB of OP_0

cases.name: stateless-genuine
cases.why: honest deployment of the stateless variant

cases.name: stateless-genuine-with-trailer
cases.why: matchesArtifact sees the trailer as code; getUtxos cuts at the OP_RETURN first and keeps it

cases.name: stateless-non-hex
cases.why: non-hex (Python: find_last_op_return raised ValueError outside getUtxos' try)

cases.name: stateless-odd-length
cases.why: odd number of hex chars

cases.name: stateless-non-ascii
cases.why: a non-ASCII char straddles the second byte window (Rust: find_last_op_return slices off a char boundary and panics)

cases.name: stateless-pushdata4-high-bit-length
cases.why: TS: findLastOpReturn, called by getUtxos outside its try, never terminates

cases.name: stateless-pushdata4-0x40-length
cases.why: Java: int pushLen*2 overflowed to a negative offset (StringIndexOutOfBoundsException escaped getUtxos)

cases.name: stateless-large-high-bit-pushdata4
cases.why: ~1 MiB of OP_PUSHDATA4 0x80000000 headers
